description: A shell script for testing git diff behavior with submodules, including various scenarios such as submodule addition, modification, deletion, nested submodules, and handling of submodule states with different options.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a git repository, commits them, and returns the commit hash.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Commits changes in the repository with a message.

methods.name: diff_cmp
methods.description: Compares two diff outputs after normalizing index hashes.
